messages:
lina.sales: Quick handoff 
Hey team, closed Sedona Analytics (Midmarket). They purchased Dedicated capacity + Private VPC for a 12-month term. Sales uploaded the signed DPA. Procurement signaled a potential renewal negotiation at month 9.
oscar.cs: Thanks Lina. Please drop SSO details, network ranges, and technical contact. Any compliance requirements?
lina.sales: Tech contact: infra@sedona.ai. Needs: SAML2 IdP + SCIM, customer-managed KMS, and strict audit logging. Contract attached in ticket SF-8399. Procurement asked for an optional mid-term discount review at month 9.
hannah.enablement: I'll own enablement and produce an onboarding runbook. Proposed 3-week runway: week0 infra & peering, week1 SSO + SCIM sync, week2 prompts/evals + perf tuning.
raj.support: I'll scope support/infra. Please create a support ticket with CIDRs, expected traffic pattern, and SAML metadata. I need KMS ARN to validate access.
lina.sales: Created SF-8399 and uploaded CIDR ranges + contract excerpt + initial SAML metadata: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-8399
violet.successops: I'll track account health and renewal signal. Suggest weekly check-ins for first 30 days, then biweekly. Flagging renewal-risk: "procurement-review" and "discount-requested".
oscar.cs: Action items & owners: 1) hannah: runbook + acceptance criteria (48h) 2) raj: scope SF-8399 infra items & ETA (48h) 3) violet: draft renewal note + dashboard tile (72h) 4) lina: share SCIM test user + final SAML metadata (ASAP).
hannah.enablement: Starting runbook now. Quick checklist: - Provision VPC peering & route tables - Request customer KMS key & run encrypt/decrypt test - Deploy private model image: redwood-dedicated-v2 - Configure SAML + SCIM test user sync - Run perf smoke: 4k tokens across 25 concurrent sessions
raj.support: Pulled SF-8399, added initial infra checklist and a tentative ETA of 4 business days pending KMS ARN and SAML certs.
lina.sales: Uploaded full SAML XML and contact (security@sedona.ai) to the ticket.
violet.successops: I'll create dashboard tiles for token usage, error rate, and prompt-eval pass rate. Also adding renewal timeline and escalation triggers.
oscar.cs: We'll capture enablement feedback via short survey after the kickoff. Use the enablement-quick form and tag responses in SF-8399.
workflow-bot: Onboarding-playbook v2.1 applied to Sedona workspace.
oscar.cs: I'll schedule the kickoff for next Thursday and post calendar invite. If anyone sees blockers, mention me directly. :calendar:
